title: Snap-fit lid
prompt: Snap-fit lid for an 80 × 60 box with 2 mm walls: an 80 × 60 × 2 mm plate (centred on the origin, Z = 0 to 2) with a 1.2 mm thick locating lip hanging 5 mm down under it that fits inside the walls with 0.2 mm clearance (lip 75.6 × 55.6 outside), a snap bead along the middle 30 mm of each long side of the lip (a Ø1.2 half-round bead centred 3.5 mm below the plate on the lip's outer face), and the plate's top edge rounded R1. Make the clearance a parameter called clearance. Make the R1 round a fillet feature.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Plate, lip and beads are one solid
80 × 60, from 5 mm below the plate to its top
The plate's top edge rounded R1 (4 edges)
Two Ø1.2 beads along X on the lip's outer faces (y = ±27.8, 3.5 mm below the plate); beads are bosses, not holes, so every swept circle counts
The lip clearance is the clearance parameter, 0.2 mm
hidden_tests.name: clearance

notes: The bead position check reads the bead's circle (drawn on YZ, extruded 30 mm symmetric along X), so it also accepts any sketch that places a Ø1.2 circle there. Construction: top_fillet reads the fillet features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test.
